'''Kuna's Tooth''', also known as '''the Tooth''', was a [[Temperature/Legends|cool]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]. The site of an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] called [[Doestes High Port]], the planet was governed by a [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]] and inhabited by members of the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]], [[Human/Legends|Human]], and [[Vashan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Kuna's Tooth hosted backalley cookhouses where [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]]-in [[Rokna tree fungus]] from the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] was processed into the [[Rokna Blue]] [[Spice/Legends|drug]] before being [[Transport/Legends|transported]] into the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==Description==
Kuna's Tooth, also referred to simply as the Tooth, was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Endor" /> located in the [[Kuna's Fist system/Legends|Kuna's Fist system]]. It lay within the [[Inner Moddell systems]] area of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]],<ref name="EAOC KunaTooth" /> one of the [[Sector/Legends|subsectors]] making up the [[Inner Zuma Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]].<ref name="EAOC KunaTooth" />

The planet was connected to the [[Annaj system/Legends|Annaj system]] by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Spar Trade Route/Legends|Spar Trade Route]], while smaller [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes linked it to the [[Kuna's Eye system/Legends|Kuna's Eye]] and [[Qina system/Legends|Qina systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Kuna's Tooth was so named since it formed a part of the [[Kuna constellation]], as seen and named by the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the planet [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]].<ref name="Endor" />

Kuna Tooth's [[local year]] lasted 215 [[Local day/Legends|local days]], each of which was seventeen [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] long. Its [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] was ninety percent standard, and it had a breathable Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and a [[Temperature/Legends|cool]] climate. The planet's surface terrain was barren.<ref name="Endor" />

==History==
Several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Endor" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] channel for the [[Rokna Blue]] [[Spice/Legends|drug]] was developed in the Moddell sector. Smugglers would [[Transport/Legends|transport]] raw [[Rokna tree fungus]] from the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] to backalley cookhouses on Kuna's Tooth. From there, the refined drug was then smuggled past Moddell [[Customs official/Legends|customs]] in the Annaj [[Star system/Legends|system]] and into the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Endor" /> Around [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]],<ref name="16 ABY">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}} establishes that [[Rokna Station]] was built twelve [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which corresponds to [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] per ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', and abandoned ten [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later.</ref> a Rokna Blue [[Rokna Station|processing station]] was also briefly maintained in the Endor system itself,<ref name="Endor" /> and [[19 ABY/Legends|three years]] later, the Rokna Blue [[Drug dealer|trade]] was no longer successful<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> outside of Moddell.<ref name="Endor" />

==Inhabitants==
Inhabited by fifty thousand [[Human/Legends|Humans]], thirty thousand [[Vashan]]s, and ten thousand Ayrou,<ref name="Endor" /> Kuna's Tooth was a hardscrabble [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world<ref name="TEA" /> governed by a [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]]. The population of the planet had access to [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-[[Technology level|level]] technology, and it exported [[Ore/Legends|ore]] off-world, while [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] and mining tools were imported.<ref name="Endor" />

Due to the location of Kuna's Tooth between the Moddell sector's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]] and the rest of the worlds of the [[Kuna systems]], it was caught in a struggle of influence between the relative order of the former and the lawlessness of the latter. As a result, the planet was kept under tight control&mdash;at least by the standards of the Moddell sector.<ref name="Endor" />

==Locations==
Kuna's Tooth had three [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]: one [[Standard Class starport|standard-class]] and two of limited services. The planet's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] also hosted a small [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] known as [[Doestes High Port]].<ref name="Endor" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kuna's Tooth was first mentioned in the article "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Endor" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square H-16.<ref name="TEA" />
